title: LOOK BACK
tagline: The Lord has been good to you.
focus_line: Grace is the undeserved kindness and power of God working in us and for us.

verse.text: The Lord is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion. The Lord protects the unwary; when I was brought low, he saved me. Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has been good to you.

session.prompt: Trace your life backward and write about some of God's most gracious moments to you. Ask Him to reveal moments where you missed His grace at the time.

coaching_notes: Today our monthly progressive discipline of journaling looks backward. Trace your life and write the specific moments God was gracious to you — and don't skip the ones that didn't feel like grace at the time. Distance has a way of often revealing God's hand in the very seasons you were sure He'd left you. Return to your rest, my soul; the Lord has been good to you.
